question: Estimate the cost of running a 5G base station / cell tower per year in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Single 5G radio site annual operating cost? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Per cell tower (with 5G NR equipment) annual cost:

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Equipment depreciation: ~₹2 lakh/year (₹15-20L radio depreciated over 7-8 years).

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: - Tower lease (if leased from Indus, ATC, Summit Digitel)
Across all 3 operators (Jio + Airtel + Vi), if tower is shared
benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~₹3 lakh in shared costs + ~₹4-5 lakh in tenant-specific = ~₹7-8L per tenant.

calculationFlow: - Tower lease (if leased from Indus, ATC, Summit Digitel): ~₹3.5-4 lakh/year per tenant.
- Power (electricity for radio + cooling + backup): ~₹1.2-1.8 lakh.
Total per tower per operator: ~₹7-8 lakh/year.
Across all 3 operators (Jio + Airtel + Vi), if tower is shared: ~₹3 lakh in shared costs + ~₹4-5 lakh in tenant-specific = ~₹7-8L per tenant.
Equipment depreciation: ~₹2 lakh/year (₹15-20L radio depreciated over 7-8 years).

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Equipment depreciation: ~₹2 lakh/year (₹15-20L radio depreciated over 7-8 years).
